name: Isobu
description: (Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)The Three-Tails, a giant red-and-white spiky-shelled turtle with great strength and surprising agility. It creates and controls water for varied techniques and opens gates to its pocket space at will. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
